svg.title: FEM-BEM Fredkin-Koehler Body-Only Pipeline
svg.desc: Two-panel schematic of FullMag's Fredkin-Koehler FEM-BEM demagnetization on a closed body-only tet4 P1 mesh Omega_m without an airbox: (a) three-stage physical splitting u = u_1 + u_2 from interior gauge-pinned Neumann Poisson u_1 through the surface double-layer BEM operator B (near CSR Lindholm + far ACA UV^T) on Gamma_m to interior Dirichlet Laplace u_2 and field recovery H_d = -grad(u_1 + u_2); (b) analytical sphere splitting u = u_1 + u_2, solid-angle diagonal B_ii geometry, and strict FEM CPU/GPU CUDA realization (atomic cuDSS or CG/AMG).
svg.text: Three-stage body-only Fredkin–Koehler splitting (u = u1 + u2, no airbox)
